newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian police seize two tons of cocaine.
newsitem.headline: Colombian police seize two tons of cocaine.

text.p: Police seized two tons of cocaine that was packed and ready for shipment overseas in a raid Friday on a small port in northwestern Colombia, authorities said.

Col. Leonardo Gallego, director of the anti-narcotics division of the National Police, said three traffickers were arrested in the raid in the small fishing village of Puerto Rey, near Colombia's border with Panama.
"This was a tough blow to the drug traffickers," Gallego told the Radionet news programme. Police also seized three fishing boats.
